statements.subject: session
statements.description: The UAS then constructs the state of the dialog. This state MUST be maintained for the duration of the dialog.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: When a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE), the UAS MUST copy all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response and MUST add a Contact header field to the response. The UAS then constructs the state of the dialog.
actions: copy all Record-Route header field values from request into response preserving order
add Contact header field to response

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the request arrived over TLS, and the Request-URI contained a SIPS URI, the 'secure' flag is set to TRUE.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The route set MUST be set to the list of URIs in the Record-Route header field from the request, taken in order and preserving all URI parameters. If no Record-Route header field is present in the request, the route set MUST be set to the empty set. This route set, even if empty, overrides any pre-existing route set for future requests in this dialog.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote target MUST be set to the URI from the Contact header field of the request.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote sequence number MUST be set to the value of the sequence number in the CSeq header field of the request.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local sequence number MUST be empty.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The call identifier component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the value of the Call-ID in the request.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the To field in the response to the request (which always includes a tag).

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag from the From field in the request. A UAS MUST be prepared to receive a request without a tag in the From field, in which case the tag is considered to have a value of null.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The remote URI MUST be set to the URI in the From field.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The local URI MUST be set to the URI in the To field.
